title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
🏡 We're Hiring! Conveyancing Paralegal – St Albans, Hertfordshire ⚖️

📍 Location: St Albans, Hertfordshire

💼 Position: Conveyancing Paralegal

💰 Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

📅 Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Are you an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal looking for your next career move?

We have a fantastic opportunity for a confident and experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to join a well-established and reputable law firm based in St Albans, Hertfordshire .

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working independently and has the experience and knowledge to manage a full residential conveyancing caseload from initial instruction right through to post-completion.

🔑 The Role

You will be responsible for independently managing your own residential conveyancing caseload, including:

✅ Handling transactions from initial instruction through to post-completion

✅ Managing freehold and leasehold sales and purchases

✅ Dealing with remortgages and transfers of equity

✅ Preparing contracts and reviewing legal documentation

✅ Conducting property searches and raising enquiries

✅ Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders and solicitors

✅ Managing exchange of contracts and completions

✅ Handling post-completion matters, including SDLT submissions and Land Registry applications

✅ Ensuring excellent client care and smooth progression of transactions

👤 About You

We are looking for someone who:

⭐ Has proven experience working as a Residential Conveyancing Paralegal

⭐ Can independently manage a full caseload from instruction through to post-completion – essential

⭐ Has a strong understanding of the residential conveyancing process

⭐ Is highly organised and able to manage competing deadlines

⭐ Has excellent communication and client care skills

⭐ Is proactive, reliable and confident working with minimal supervision

🎯 What's on Offer?

✨ Competitive salary depending on experience

✨ Supportive and professional working environment

✨ Opportunity to join an established and respected law firm

✨ Varied and interesting residential conveyancing caseload

✨ Long-term career development opportunities

📩 Interested? Let's Talk!

If you're an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal looking for a new opportunity in St Albans, Hertfordshire , I'd love to hear from you!

📧 Send your CV to francesca@a1personnel.co.uk

All enquiries will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Know someone who could be a great fit? Please tag them or share this opportunity with your network!
